'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Olenivka prison explosion]]
****[[Russia]] and the [[Donetsk People's Republic]] (DPR) say that 53 people were killed and 75 others injured after [[shell (projectile)|shelling]] hit a prison holding Ukrainian [[prisoners of war]] in the DPR-controlled city of [[Olenivka, Kalmiuske Raion|Olenivka]], [[Donetsk Oblast]]. Russia and [[Ukraine]] accuse each other of carrying out the strike. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-donetsk-prisoners-of-war-30e2e205bab0081c576b944baae82a61 (AP)]
***[[War crimes in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****A video emerges on [[social media]] of a [[Russian Ground Forces|Russian soldier]] [[castration|castrating]] a Ukrainian prisoner of war in the town of [[Sievierodonetsk]], Donetsk Oblast. The video has not been independently verified. The [[Government of Ukraine|Ukrainian government]] voices outrage over the incident and vows retaliation against the perpetrators. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-62344358 (BBC News)] [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2022/07/29/ukrainian-pow-castrated-russian-troops-horrifying-footage/ (''The Telegraph'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jul/29/video-appears-to-show-russian-soldier-castrating-ukrainian-prisoner (''The Guardian'')] [https://news.sky.com/story/footage-appears-to-show-ukrainian-prisoner-of-war-being-castrated-by-russian-soldiers-12661176 (Sky News)]
***A Russian strike kills five civilians and injures seven others at a bus stop in [[Mykolaiv]], according to [[Governor of Mykolaiv Oblast|regional governor]] [[Vitaliy Kim]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/russian-strikes-kill-4-at-bus-stop-in-south-ukraine-governor-01659082507 (AFP News via ''Barron's'')]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**A 16-year-old [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] affiliated with [[Fatah]] is killed during clashes with [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] in [[Al-Mughayyir, Ramallah|Al-Mughayyir]], near [[Ramallah]]. [https://www.albawaba.com/news/israeli-forces-shoot-dead-youth-palestinian-cold-blood-1485582 (''Al Bawaba'')] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/palestinian-teen-said-killed-in-clashes-with-idf-northeast-of-ramallah/ (''Times of Israel'')]
*Two people are killed and 11 are injured during a hand grenade attack at a [[cricket]] game in [[Kabul]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-islamic-state-group-sports-taliban-cricket-26ce703e726a1076a9d4f48565775217 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[July 2022 United States floods]]
**The death toll from the ongoing [[flash flood]]s in [[Kentucky]], [[United States]], increases to 25. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/07/29/weather/kentucky-appalachia-flooding-friday/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2022 United Arab Emirates floods]]
**The [[United Arab Emirates|UAE]] records its heaviest rainfall in 27 years, with seven people killed by flooding in the Emirates of [[Emirate of Sharjah|Sharjah]] and [[Emirate of Fujairah|Fujairah]]. [https://www.khaleejtimes.com/uae/uae-six-expats-found-dead-after-floods-say-authorities (''Khaleej Times'')]
*The death toll of the recent floods in [[Iran]] has risen to at least 53. [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/07/30/world/middleeast/iran-deadly-flood.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://news.yahoo.com/iran-raises-death-toll-mudslides-200628430.html (Yahoo! News)]
*One person is killed and one is missing after a fire at an oil refinery in [[Tamaulipas]], [[Mexico]]. [https://apnews.com/article/fires-mexico-accidents-40111170cb9b68fff41eda15fb0a02db (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in the United States]]
***[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in New York (state)|2022 monkeypox outbreak in New York]]
****[[New York (state)|New York state]] declares an emergency due to the ongoing monkeypox outbreak. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/ny-declares-monkeypox-emergency-as-cases-continue-to-rise/ar-AA105W9b?ocid=entnewsntp&cvid=4268bb8346f947d191ad62da382fc785 (MSN)]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]] reports its first death from monkeypox in a 41-year-old man from [[Belo Horizonte]] who had [[lymphoma]] and a weakened [[immune system]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazil-confirms-its-first-monkeypox-related-death-2022-07-29/ (Reuters)]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Canada]]
***The [[Smallpox vaccine|monkeypox vaccine]] will be made available to high-risk people in [[British Columbia]], [[Canada]]. [https://vancouversun.com/news/local-news/b-c-making-monkeypox-vaccine-available-to-anyone-in-province (''Vancouver Sun'')]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in the Philippines]]
***The [[Philippines]] reports its first case of [[monkeypox]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/philippines-reports-first-case-of-monkeypox-from-returning-filipino (''Straits Times'')]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Spain]]
***[[Spain]] reports [[Europe]]'s first death from monkeypox. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jul/29/spain-reports-first-death-in-europe-related-to-monkeypox-outbreak (''The Guardian'')]
*[[West Nile virus in the United States]]
**[[Colorado]] reports a case of [[West Nile virus]] in a person from [[Delta County, Colorado|Delta County]]. [https://www.fox21news.com/news/colorados-first-human-case-of-west-nile-virus-identified-for-2022/ (KXRM-TV)]
*It is reported that the first [[United States]] case of [[polio]] since 2013, which was reported last week in [[Rockland County, New York|Rockland County]], [[New York (state)|New York]], was connected to traces of vaccine-derived viruses found in the [[United Kingdom]] and [[Israel]]. [https://www.propublica.org/article/polio-london-jerusalem-new-york (ProPublica)] [https://www.statnews.com/2022/07/29/u-s-polio-case-tied-to-viruses-detected-in-u-k-israel-suggesting-silent-spread/ (Stat)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Visit by Pope Francis to Canada]]
**[[Pope Francis]] visits [[Iqaluit]] in [[Nunavut]] to apologize for the past abuse and cultural suppression at [[Canadian Indian residential school system|Catholic residential schools]] in [[Canada]]. The visit is his final stop on his Canada trip. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/north/pope-francis-iqaluit-nunavut-visit-1.6535224 (CBC)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[War crimes in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[Trial of Vadim Shishimarin]]
**A court in [[Kyiv]] reduces the [[sentence (law)|sentence]] of Vadim Shishimarin, the first [[Russian soldier]] tried for [[war crime]]s, from [[life in prison]] to 15 years detention. Shishimarin's defense attorney says that it is "highly likely" that he will be returned to [[Russia]] in a prisoner exchange. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/ukrainian-court-lowers-russian-soldiers-war-crimes-sentence-87613503 (ABC News)]
